name: Kendo-ComfyUI-H3 Fast v3 beta
readme: Kendo MiniMax H3 Ref2VA Turbo studio v3 beta. Adds optional FlashVSR temporal video upscaling after native 1 MP generation, with 2x or 4x output and Fast, Balanced, Long Video, or High Quality modes. Supports 9 image references, 1 video reference, and 3 audio references. Existing v2 remains unchanged.
